name: io.github.camerxnduff/x402-router
title: x402 Router
description: Search 24.5k+ live, probed x402 endpoints; route to the best. Hosted MCP with in-MCP x402 payments.

tools.name: search_x402_endpoints
tools.description: Search the router's continuously probed registry of ~24,000 LIVE x402 pay-per-call endpoints. Returns the best-ranked matches with price (USDC), crawl latency, reliability_pct (share of the last <=20 probes that answered HTTP 402), networks and payTo. Free.

q.description: Free-text task or keyword, e.g. 'weather', 'image generation', 'token price'

category.description: Category filter, e.g. AI, Data, Finance, Search

chain.description: Chain filter: Base, Solana, or a CAIP-2 id like eip155:8453

max_price.description: Maximum price per call in USDC, e.g. 0.05

tools.name: route_x402_request
tools.description: Pick the best-scored LIVE x402 endpoint for a task and return it with the top 3 alternatives (the same answer as the free POST /route). For a live-checked pick with fallbacks and the full ranked list, see get_paid_route_requirements. Free.

chain.description: Chain filter: Base, Solana, or a CAIP-2 id like eip155:8453

max_price.description: Maximum price per call in USDC, e.g. 0.05

tools.name: compare_x402_endpoints
tools.description: Compare 2-5 x402 endpoints side by side (pass urls), or the top 5 matches for a task (pass q/category/chain/max_price): price, latency, reliability over the last crawl probes, valid 402, networks and payTo, with a winner plus the cheapest, fastest and most reliable. Free.

chain.description: Chain filter: Base, Solana, or a CAIP-2 id like eip155:8453

tools.name: get_endpoint_reliability
tools.description: Probe history of one x402 endpoint url: status, success rate over the last <=20 crawl probes, consecutive failures, last seen. Returns found=false for urls the router does not track. Free.

tools.name: get_x402_changes
tools.description: Recent payTo (receiving wallet) and price changes of x402 endpoints, observed by the router's own crawl probes of the live 402. Only values that were stable and then changed are alerts; endpoints that use per-request deposit addresses or metered prices are classified (payto_rotating / price_dynamic) instead. Filter by host or exact url before paying an endpoint. Free.

tools.name: get_paid_route_requirements
tools.description: x402 v2 payment requirements and copy-paste client code for POST https://router-production-ab89.up.railway.app/route/paid (0.01 USDC on Base; Solana accepted): a best endpoint re-checked live seconds before answering, up to 4 fallbacks and the full ranked list (up to 25). Includes the free trial (3 calls/day with header X-402-Trial: <wallet>). The same answer is sold inside MCP by the route_paid tool. This tool never pays; your x402 client does.

tools.name: get_router_stats
tools.description: Live proof numbers: registry size and freshness, LIVE endpoints, reliability buckets, uptime, settled paid requests and trial usage (aggregates only). Free.

tools.name: route_paid
tools.description: Paid (0.01 USDC via x402, Base; Solana accepted): the same answer as POST https://router-production-ab89.up.railway.app/route/paid. The best endpoint is re-checked live seconds before answering, with up to 4 fallbacks, the full ranked list (up to 25) with reliability_pct, and paying wallets get their last good endpoint tried first. Pay inside the call: without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object; retry with the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"] (x402 MCP transport, e.g. @x402/mcp). The receipt is in result._meta["x402/payment-response"].
